statement_verbatim: statement: A product capability should be separable — its internal cohesion (intra-capability shared-token DESIRED OUTCOME edges) at least its tightest coupling to any single neighbor product capability. A product capability more bound to a neighbor than to itself emits a [MERGE] signal. Advisory and non-blocking.
statement: Convert between logical slugs and filesystem names by swapping hyphens and underscores.

statement: 'A telemetry URN maps to a filesystem directory of signal files: telemetry:{theme}:{segments}
  -> telemetry/{theme}/{segments}/{signal-type}.{plane}[.{measure}].json.'
statement: A product capability URN is capability:{kebab-case-name}, preferring a verb-object slug; built via URNBuilder.capability.
statement: Product capabilities declare a stable URN and live under plan/<capability-slug>/ with the documented file layout.

statement: Component names are derived from artifact resources by converting the resource
  to PascalCase and adding a capability suffix chosen by the artifact type (events,
  states, data, configs).

statement: Each component must have a single business capability, and its name must
  reflect that primary business purpose.

statement: A feature must have at most 8 components; beyond 8 indicates the feature
  is too large and should be split.

statement: Components are derived from feature analysis — from ioSeeds triggers (events,
  commands, queries) and from DESIRED OUTCOME verbs (validate, process, display, persist, coordinate)
  — each trigger generating a component with a business capability and layer.

statement: A component's consumed and produced events must be a subset of the owning
  feature's ioSeeds; every event must be traceable to a feature ioSeed.

statement: A component is assigned to an architectural layer based on its artifact
  type and responsibility, using the typical-layer mapping for events, states, data,
  and configs.

statement: A component belongs to exactly one architectural layer, and its URN must
  contain a valid layer value.

statement: A component must have at most 5 methods; split the component if more methods
  are needed.

statement: A generated component carries a complete structure — URN, required parent
  feature, templated description, consumed/produced events (max 3 each), and dependencies.

statement: The canonical component type catalog enumerates every component type by
  side (backend|frontend), layer, file suffix per language, description, and complexity
  weight, derived from the coder backend/frontend conventions.

statement: Every contract URN on a product capability produce/consume must resolve to a contract registered in contracts/_contracts.yaml; no cross-capability produce/consume edge may carry contract null; every produced contract must have a consumer or be explicitly marked external.

statement: >-
  Operative prose in a convention node — the fix_hint, operational_guidance,
  normative_text, statement and term text a reader is expected to ACT on — must
  name only files that exist in the repo and only CLI verbs that still resolve.
  A fix_hint is an executable promise: if it names a file, that file must be
  there; if it names a verb, that verb must run.
